description: Windows toolkit that explains your PC in plain language: Fix my PC finds what's wrong and fixes it safely, and Tune my PC sets it up for gaming, creative work or low power.
notes: Hanki Tools isn't code-signed yet. Scoop verifies the download against the SHA-256 checksum published with the release.
This bucket follows the newest Hanki Tools release, including previews.
Scan history and recovery records are kept in %LOCALAPPDATA%\IgezziGuard, outside the Scoop folder.
